empty.title: No tasks yet

noMatches.title: No tasks in this view match the search or filters.

inView.other: {{view}} has {{count}} tasks. Search looks at titles, keys and briefs.

emptyView.title: No tasks in this view.
emptyView.active: A task shows here once it is Todo, In progress or In review, or waits for you.
emptyView.backlog: A task shows here while its workflow status is Backlog.
emptyView.done: A task shows here once it is Done or Canceled.
emptyView.all: A task shows here once it is created.

outsideTasks.body: This list shows tasks only. The Needs you panel lists everything that waits for you.

shared.removedTitle: You're no longer a member of {{project}} on {{server}}
shared.removedBody: {{server}} answered at {{time}} that you aren't in {{project}} any more. This computer keeps {{key}}'s {{count}} tasks as they were then, read-only. Runs already going here finish; none can start. Make {{project}} local to keep working here, or ask an owner, {{owners}}, to add you again.

title.one: 1 task stayed on this computer when {{project}} joined {{key}}
title.other: {{count}} tasks stayed on this computer when {{project}} joined {{key}}

notShared.body: {{keys}} weren't ticked on {{day}}. They keep their key, runs, conversations and memory here, read-only and out of the shared list. Share task on a task's page uploads it to {{server}} with the next {{key}} number.
notShared.foundOne: {{key}} {{title}} stayed on this computer as Not shared.
notShared.foundMany: {{count}} tasks that match stayed on this computer as Not shared.
